40k Fireside: Liam is a very clever list builder actually. Um he lists builds to have just enough tools for every single situation in such a way that you need to be able to use all the tools correctly to get the most of the list. Chosen advance fallback shoot charge

Major strats:
Reactive move 6” if you move within 8” for INFANTRY (Oblits / Muts are infantry)
Advance fall back shoot for infantry
Armor of contempt
Ignore cover
Masters can cast a psychic grenade
Heal a daemon / psyker unit D3+1, can restore models. Nearly everything is daemon/psyker.
